name: Riesling
message: 「Do I look to be in a better mood than usual...」

name: Riesling
message: 「To think I would let my inner thoughts show on my face--it seems I am still quite inexperienced」

name: Riesling
message: 「Actually, today, the Young Lady, the Master, and the Madam have said they will celebrate my birthday for me」

name: Riesling
message: 「Such words are far too generous for someone like me」

name: Riesling
message: 「You will celebrate with me as well? And even a present」

name: Riesling
message: 「My emotions showed on my face. It seems I truly still have much to learn」
